reviews.text: Very friendly at reception and got us in quickly. Dr. Banks was so thorough in her explanations we left feeling very confident in our dogs treatment.

I loved everything except the price.

I’ve just moved back from Spain, where things were 1/4 of the price of what they are here in the US. I thought with the Population we have in this country; isn't it a basic financial Strategy that we should get better deals than what we get? Instead, to me it’s a “bottom line“ type of society.

The care was very good.

Exceptional care from start to finish! From the quick appointment availability to the compassion, empathy, and time spent educating us was outstanding. The doctors and staff are truly amazing and go above and beyond to ensure my dog receives the very best care. I’m so grateful for cardiologist Dr. Marisa Ciccozzi and her expertise and care along with the rest of the staff.
Everybody works VSH are nice, specially the doctor is extremely great.

Expertise coupled with compassion characterizes this facility. From Doctors, Nurses, and Technicians, you will receive the best in veterinary care and support. They seem to love your pet as much as you do, or close! We are blessed to have this gem in our community! My dog received life-saving care there this past week and they get 5 stars from Paloma and me!
Excellent service from top to bottom! From the initial call to bringing our pup home, it was top notch. Only place we will take our dogs for emergency visits!
I went VSH San Marcos for a internal medicine specialist. They were very thorough, thoughtful and kind. It was rather expensive but I know that the best attention was given to my cat.
The staff are so kind. We took our dog in for the last time and they we very clear and supportive and helped the passing of our dog a comfortable one in such a hard time. Thank you so much.

After my dog had two herniated disks and needed immediate spine surgery we took her in to get seen at this facility. I could not be more grateful on all of their care and support for her during this time. The staff is beyond amazing, always happy to help and answer any questions I have . ( even the questions at 1am) Dr. Ganyapon continued to keep me updated about her condition, and where they were during the process of getting her healed back to health. She stayed for two nights and I 100% felt better knowing she was in great hands. This has been the best vet treatment facility I’ve experienced.
Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are so happy to hear that you had a great experience. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon!
Very caring with my fur baby!
Oakley was provided outstanding personal care by your staff
my experience was great and now my dog is better

Everything was awesome Except the wait!! That we awful we give 1 star on the wait. they only had one doc in staff that’s insane with how much money you guys make from us you should have a lot of docs available to help emergencies I hope your new place offers this. We are also disappointed with you guys moving as it’s far from where we are now :(
Excellent, quick and efficient care. So glad we found this place.

We brought our cat in with an unknown issue causing a swollen, drippy eye. We were referred to the ER by our regular vet. Dr. Pham was our assigned physician and we couldn’t have felt better taken care of. Not only was she extremely knowledgeable but she was the kindest person. You can tell she cares very much for the animals she treats. The compassion she showed me as we were trying to determine what was going on with my little guy was unmatched.
Professional, on time with my appointment, very patient and thorough with my dog.

We have 4 dogs - and with those dogs comes a share of challenges.. The latest one was our Basenji decided to sneak and eat 12 large double chunk chocolate chip cookies... I called first - they had me give the weight of the dog and estimate the amount of chocolate consumed... Yep! It was an emergency. Upon arrival, they saw her quickly and were extremely communicative about the process and the "what ifs". They were able to take a conservative approach (made her throw up) - which saved us oodles of money. Really appreciate VSH!
Exceptional.  Communicative and efficient.
I am so grateful for the special care my cat Gizmo received during a difficult time
Very caring and thorough exam and diagnosis. She has improved so much and I’m so very thankful.
I was disappointed by the lack of support during my pet emergency. It felt like the company's focus was more on profit than on helping customers when they needed it most.

Responsive, professional, caring. My dog had surgery and they kept me up to date during the procedure.  They realize they are caring for a family member.

We also had two issues with our dog's eyes. In both cases we first sought treatment with our local veterinarian with no success.  Dr. Banks was able to solve the problems, one of which  had turned into a significant infection before we got to her.  She is exceptional at what she does.

Our 9 year old yellow lab needed a bilateral TPLO, which was performed by Dr. Sidhu. He and the team were fantastic—keeping us updated from drop off, through the surgery, and to pickup.

And the surgery was a success. A couple of months later, her x-rays are clear and she’s walking normally. We’re so grateful to Dr. Sidhu and the entire team at VSH North County for everything they did to give our dog a new lease on life.

I had to take my dog Paisley in the middle of the night because she was peeing blood. When we went in, the staff was incredibly friendly, and they were SO quick in getting us the help she needed! The doctor was great about discussing options, and we were in and out faster than I would have ever thought. Thank you so much VSH!
Great experience. Compassionate and caring staff. From check in to after surgery care has all been exemplary. I thank your staff very much.

VSH is like the Cedars Sinai for pets. Top notch facility and care. Shout out to the Emergency team. I had to bring my dog in on emergency. Despite being terrified, the VSH team handled every single step with precision, intelligence and care. My senior boy has multiple health struggles that complicated things- the team took everything in and navigated his care based on his history. It was really impressive.

This is my 3rd experience bringing a dog here and each time has been similar.

You guys rock!!!
Quickly too care of my pet.  Very competent staff
Very thorough and detailed!  The cost was $500 less than the estimate. I felt that my little one was in very good hands!

From the first phone call on a Sunday to the visit itself, all team staff were attentive, kind, reassuring as our sweet lab was in bad shape from an allergic reaction to an insect sting or bite.  It was our first emergency visit as this was over the weekend, and we are relieved at the quick healing of our lab and to have an emergency source should we need this again. Highly recommend!

Definitely 5 stars, would give them 10 stars if I could. This place is absolutely wonderful. The front desk folks were very friendly and caring, and the doctors are amazing. Our fur baby needed an MRI and then surgery, and we were kept apprised of his course of care every step of the way. First, they were very patient and sympathetic when I called to check if he’d had his MRI yet (even though they had told us they would call us when it was done), called promptly after the MRI to discuss the next steps, called us immediately after surgery to let us know how it went, then called the next 2 mornings to check in and update us (he spent 2 nights).  And of course those procedures are not cheap, but their costs were quite reasonable, less than I expected, honestly. I sincerely hope we never have need of a hospital/surgery again but if we do, we’ll be coming here.

excellent care.
excellent service. clean hospital. very efficient. always answered phone when we called to check on our pup. knowledgeable, patient, excellent bedside manner.
Very good service and good workers totally recommend it

Dr Elizabeth Gagnepain was fantastic she did a great job with my dog blue, he wasn’t able to walk without falling over. He was incontinent due to the injury of the IVDD, Now it’s like he’s a new dog. It’s like nothing ever really happened. It’s now 5 weeks after the surgery, He’s up walking normal running around like a brand new dog!! Thanks, Dr. G
Amazing experience. Staff is incredibly helpful and friendly. The doctor took time and listen and give us options. Highly recommend.
They were very helpful and knowledgeable.  I felt my dog got great care.

My experience was very bad.  I was made to wait 4.5 hours for my dogs sore foot to be looked at but not treated.  This was not due to emergency cases coming in as none did for the first 2 hours I was there.  I was told after 15 minutes of arriving that my dog would be seen "next".  At hours 3.5 I was shown a treatment plan that included many padded costs - example would be a $300+ charge to sedate my dog while they put a bandage on her foot even though they told me she was cooperating fully and being "very sweet'.  That was one of many.  After waiting another hour without a simple bandage being put on I demanded my dog back, which they tried to refuse and then I took her home, put a bandage on myself and saved $500+ dollars from their quoted treatment plan.  My dog was fine the next day.  DONT TRUST THEM.
The staff all are very helpful and pleasant. It is obvious that those dealing directly with our fur babies really care about their welfare.

We paid a small fortune to them! Our dog was diagnosed with Cushings disease. We saw Dr Rob. How I regret seeing her! We used to call the office and she never called back us back! It was one of the most unpleasant experiences of my life! I expected specialist experience, expertise and advice but received none. She was disgrace as were the the staff on the phones. I do not recommend taking your pet there, as they did not provide any helpful health advice for our beloved dog! I don’t usually give such reviews, but I really felt compelled to share my and my family’s awful experience there!

I come in with my dog who has an aggressive and mysterious cancer, asking for non opioid medications that have been shown to work for him to alleviate his suffering. They say sit down and we will talk to the vet then come back and say no problem he will provide the needed meds so your dog doesn’t suffer. I wait almost an hour and then they come back and say no, you need to call back in the morning and just let him suffer all night. So why have me sit for an hour after telling me that you are doing something only to then come back and say you aren’t doing it and I need to call back in the morning. I’m not asking for opioids. They wasted an hour of my time after lying to me and they don’t care at all if he is suffering all night. They could have had me leave a long time ago instead of lying and keeping me here until 10:00 at night. This is unprofessional, uncaring, and they have zero concern about actually helping a suffering animal. I can’t believe I sat here and waiting an hour based on their lies. So I say let me talk to the actual vet and now I’m waiting for who knows how much longer. Never come here!!!!!

Awesome staff. They made an awful experience, easy thoughtful, kind. I just can’t say enough about your staff.
I’m so very very grateful to everyone. A few people specifically just can’t remember names right now.
Callie Queen and I Thank you 🙏

I want other pet owners to know exactly what happened here, because I made a 6-hour round-trip decision based on what this hospital told me, and every key thing turned out to be wrong.

My dog Mousse suddenly lost the use of his back legs (IVDD), and time was critical. I spent last week calling dozens of vets for pricing. On Thursday afternoon, I called this hospital and was quoted $5,000–$9,000 for the MRI and surgery. I asked specifically whether that price included both the MRI and the surgery, because every hospital in LA had quoted me $14,000–$15,000, and I was told yes. I also asked, explicitly, if a neurologist could see him that night if I arrived before 8pm. I was told yes, they were on call until 8.

So I took a three-hour Uber with my paralyzed dog, trusting he’d be cared for on arrival. I got there at 7pm. They checked him in. Fifteen minutes later I was told the neurologist was NOT coming that night, he’d be seen “in the morning.” Then I was told the actual cost would be $15,000, not the $5,000–$9,000 I was quoted hours earlier. No reasonable person drives three hours each way with a paralyzed dog to pay the same price quoted at home, the only reason I made that trip was the quote they gave me.
When I asked them to pull the recorded call to verify what I’d been told, I was informed no one could access the recording until Monday, and that someone would follow up. No one ever did. I had to call them myself a full week later (today) at which point I was told the call “wasn’t recorded,” despite their phone system announcing that calls may be recorded. When I escalated, the supervisor admitted that the front desk should never have quoted me prices at all and that she could not confirm what I was actually told on that call.
To make it worse: the only thing offered that night was an ER exam I didn’t need, my dog had already been evaluated by two ER vets that week. I came for a neurologist. During that exam, when I expressed concern that Mousse was in obvious pain I had to ask for pain medication for my suffering dog.
I took another three-hour Uber home with nothing resolved. Between the inaccurate quote, the neurologist who was promised and never showed, the “unrecorded” call, and the complete lack of follow-up, this was one of the most emotionally draining experiences of an already devastating week.
I would never recommend this place to anyone who loves their animal.

Imani and Mousse

Hi Sheri, thank you so much for sharing your positive experience with us! We're thrilled to hear that Dr. Banks provided exceptional care for your dog's emergency eye surgery. We appreciate your recommendation and are always here should you need us again. Take care!

I called for an emergency. I explained my pet situation,  and immediately booked me. As I walked in, they were very fast to remembered my conversation, I just had with them. A vet assistant, evaluate my dog. And, In about 5 minutes my dog was being taking care. Great Service  Thank You! 🐕‍🦺🐕🦮! …
Thank you Dr Banks and team for saving my eye. Love, Oliver Norse the Bichon Frise

The entire staff was friendly and accommodating during the medical emergency with my dog. Dr. Banks was very helpful and took the time to explain the treatment plan and answered all of my questions. The pricing was surprisingly reasonable and the treatment plan worked!
Very professional and effective care. Annalisa has given us hope and confidence.  During this very dark and difficult time, she provides us with light.
Excellent care and couldn’t thank them more for saving our Pavo puppy! They called every morning and evening with an update and we’re available anytime during the day and night if needed.

Second time there and staff are consistently friendly & helpful:) Hospital is spacious & clean & has a calming atmosphere (I love the art & the photos throughout). Dr. Banks was very attentive, informative, kind & helpful; taking her time to explain everything thoroughly. My highly sensitive senior doggie was handled mindfully & Dr. Banks & the staff were very warm to him which helped him relax & feel comfortable. Dr. Banks was extraordinarily attentive to him & his needs, & he absolutely loved her!:) Thank you for the excellent care & service! It means a lot & makes all the difference for us doggy parents especially when already navigating a stressful and/or complex medical situation. Hope to continue my baby’s care at this clinic:)
Very kind and thorough with testing and recommendations for my sick cat. It’s been 3 days since I took him in and so far he hasn’t had any issues. Thank you!
Thank you so much for the wonderful 5-star review! We truly appreciate your kind words and are grateful for the trust you place in our team. ❤️🐾 …

We had an excellent experience. The staff was incredibly kind, compassionate, and attentive throughout the entire process. They took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure we felt supported every step of the way. It was evident how much they genuinely care about both their patients and the families behind them. During such a stressful time with our Ellie girl, their kindness meant more than we can put into words especially when they generously covered a couple of treatments. We’re truly grateful for everything you did. Thank you again.

My experience was above average!!!   They met my every need, plus more , for my dog,  Tucker, who was very frightened.
Dr. Mallery is so very knowledgeable and kind, making everything he told me understandable.
I would recommend this hospital to anyone.

The process was very smooth. Great communication with paperwork filled out online. Very little wait time . The cardiologist was AMAZING. Went through all the paperwork with me. Was very patient , and took her time responding to the questions that I had .Will definitely be going back again. A+
It was excellent, as always!  Great care!  Dr. Scherrer did a wonderful job and Ulysses was competent and cordial.

My dog Helmet was diagnosed with IVDD (a disc herniation) and needed spinal surgery to relieve the pressure on his spine. One thing that stood out is their neurosurgeons are on-site 5 days a week, unlike a lot of other vet practices, which made getting him seen and treated so much faster. Throughout the whole process, from diagnosis to surgery to recovery, the doctor was incredibly communicative and kept us informed every step of the way. Helmet is now recovering well at home, and we’re so grateful for the care and clear communication we got here. Highly recommend!

I am thankful for the Veterinary Specialty Hospital as I have used a/an Cardiologist, Orthopedic Surgeon for my past Cavalier King Charles Spaniels, and an Ophthalmologist for my current Shih Tzu born with a congenital birth defect.  They were all great and I totally felt confident with their knowledge and treatments.

Horrible place, I almost lost my cat due to their negligence. Truly a place that only cares about money. I brought my baby in after his normal vet found a cyst on his kidney, a truly unprofessional lady with orange hair brought me in to a room to pay the expected bill, as I was questioning and analyzing the bill after the most earth shattering news that my baby boy who is 14 and has thyroid disease had a huge cyst squishing his organs she without a heart said “I’m ready to take the payment whenever you are” as I’m breaking down emotionally. I questioned why he was going to be sedated since it’s not an invasive procedure and he’s a 14 very calm cat with no teeth, she simply said we always have to sedate them and he’s already sedated. I lost it as this was never discussed with me. They had him for 3 hours before they even brought me into the room. Never updated me on how he was. The last straw after I had paid she was just staring at me and simply said you can come back later for him. As if my baby was just dry cleaning, never gave me a time frame or anything. I requested a supervisor and she sent in someone who wasn’t a supervisor to talk to me, he clarified things like that my cat was not sedated without my knowledge and he agreed that his coworker acted inappropriately. They kept him for over 8 hours, he had rarely eaten or drank water because of his condition they charged me about $400 ADDITIONALLY to “SQUEEZE” him in… but didn’t have the foresight to ADD AN IV TO THE BILL. THEY ONLY CARE ABOUT THEMSELVES NOT OUR BABIES. Thank god I did not continue treatment there and instead took him somewhere else where they immediately put him on an IV for a whole day because of how dehydrated he was. They can charge thousands of dollars for their service but the service doesn’t include actually caring or aiding the heath of their patients. Disgusting money hungry place
Very professional, courteous, empathetic and caring staff.  Pleasant ambiance, and very clean.  Dr. John Gagnepain is truly an outstanding veterinary neurologist and an amazing human being.

Taking a pet to the emergency clinic is very stressful but VSH was amazing! The staff was very caring. They were very thorough and explained all procedures they wanted to do. I hope I don’t need them in the future, but if I do, I will not hesitate to go there.

Our dog went down with a herniated disc and required surgery for IVDD. I brought him here on a recommendation from my local emergency vet. We had a wonderful experience here. The surgery was successful, and I received updates from the doctor every morning regarding my dog’s recovery. Highly recommend their services.
Thank you for the 5 stars! We’re so grateful for your support and appreciate you choosing our team for your pet’s care. It means so much to us! 💙 …

Had a wonderful and refreshing experience at this clinic. I took my 10 pound poodle in for a visit due to a Luxating patella that was giving her issues. Dr. William was extremely kind, patient, thorough, and caring. He drew several diagrams explaining my dogs issues, answered all my questions, explored different treatment paths and the pros/ cons of each, and gave me a referral to a primary vet. The appointment lasted ~45 mins and he never rushed us once. Although the visit was a bit pricey, it’s worth every penny to talk to a true field expert. I highly recommend this clinic and specially Dr. William’s expertise!

Great - my baby had an allergic reaction in the middle of the night. She looked like she was in a bar fight. We drove to VSH in SM and they were very helpful and didn’t charge me an arm and a leg. Hopefully won’t have to go back anytime soon but wouldn’t hesitate if we need to!

Dr. Scherrer and his team are wonderful! Junie (malinois/pitbull 85 lbs) had an ACL tear that required a TPLO. We had a great experience with quality patient education and service. Dr. Scherrer personally made several phone calls to check on Junie during the healing process. We also had to bring Junie into the ER (we are overly cautious) and the care provided was exceptional. The ER team had direct contact with the surgical team and provided clear communication regarding Junie’s status with thorough follow up. Finally, the front desk staff was always kind and helpful when we called at all hours day and night with questions and concerns following this procedure. A TPLO is a major surgery for pups and I cannot recommend this group enough to manage your family members care.
Wonderful and efficient dog cancer care
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and are so grateful you chose us for your pet’s care. We’re happy to have you and your furry family as part of our community! ❤️
Great experience Rusty had no stress and the procedure was fast
Great experience! Vet answered all questions and was caring.
Loved seeing Dr. Gagnepain again!

Everyone here is wonderful. I was referred here by her PCP (West Coast Animal Hospital) to Dr. John Gagnepain (neurology). My sweet girl Lotta had been having trouble walking and weakness in her rear legs. She was in discomfort that was not controlled by medication alone. The team and dr. Gagnepain spent time doing a very thorough neurological exam . They did notice a lump I had not seen as well and she was evaluated by the on sight oncologist (she was fine)!  The doctor spent a lot of time talking to me about her symptoms and when we had a diagnosis spent time going over her treatment options.

She was able to have an MRI that same day and receive her first epidural. Unfortunately she does have severe degenerative disc disease, but they recommended a 3 injection epidural protocol. She had her last treatment today. My dog has shown tremendous progress and is once again able to enjoy walks and age appropriate activity. They did a final exam and she has shown a very promising response to her treatment plan. They also are available for followups and questions by mail.

My dog is 12 and I was nervous about putting her under anesthesia and sedation, but they did all the right pre anesthesia diagnostics and she had done just fine.

The facility itself is clean and nice. I can’t think of a single bad thing to say about this place. I would 100% trust them with your dog’s care. Dr. Gagnepain is amazing, but im sure everyone else here is as well. Everyone here is compassionate from check in, care, and check out.

Thank you so much for letting me pay for her treatment through Paws of Honor and thanks for taking such good care of my former work partner and now retired buddy.

While you never want to have to need to take your pets to the ER, Veterinary Speciality Hospital North County has been there for us in the moments where we needed them most.  The whole team is empathetic and responsive- helping address concerns in a timely manner during an already stressful moment. After many visits over the years, they are our go to hospital to help our pack. Thank you team!

I took my 4 month old kitten to this hospital since our own veterinary clinic was already closed.
The young veterinarian was talking extra fast and without paying any attention to what I was saying with regards to the situation.
My kitten apparently ate something that was too much for his system to handle and throw up a couple of times ,plus diarrhea and fever.
My mini poodle had tge much milder version of it without fever. Therefore it was obvious to me that my kitten was not in mortal danger.
But, the young doctor wanted to do every test that he learned at the school to perform on my little kitten.
When I finally had to tell him ,what I would like to have done for now, which was hydration, medication for vomiting and diarrhea. He abruptly got up and left.
From that moment I was treated with cold shoulder and rolling eyes by everyone. They refused to give Purrcy any medication for diarrhea and sold me upon my insistence some pro-biotic capsules for $40.00
All together they charged me over $410.00
Just for exam, hydration and vomiting injection.
My kitten was absolutely back to normal the next morning.
We have Pet insurance for both of our pets,  but, that doesn't mean it should be abused by anyone.
We will not go back to VSH again.
Mariam Tripp

This is the vet you take your fur babies when they need the most compassionate care available.  Even with a full waiting room, they get you seen, put you at ease, and get your babies taken care of.  All of the staff is friendly and the Veterinarians are fabulous!!
Nice facility with sweet staff. Dr. Gagnepain in neurology was amazing. Thorough with excellent knowledge. Felt in the best hands. Thank you!
Thank you for the 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are delighted you had a great experience. We look forward to serving you again!

Disappointed I want to be clear this is not about failure of the front desk, the doctors, technicians or the surgical team it is about what happened after our dog was released and the lack of communication and lack of response even after numerous calls including those selected as their emergency option on the phone.

We brought our 9 ½ year old German Shepherd in Sunday afternoon because he was acting poorly did not eat and hid in a dark place. Anyone who knows of dog behavior these actions are where a dog senses they are in peril. We took him into Veterinary Specialty Hospital VSH which is a 24 hour emergency and they quickly diagnosed internal bleed and an operation to remove his spleen. They explained this was critical and major surgery costing $13,000 to 15,000 dollars. We OK’ed surgery and he had his spleen removed + biopsy for cancer. The surgeon was very professional and answer all our questions. The people that took care of him were caring and great.They kept him for about 2 1/2 days and the care and communications were excellent. Many thanks to the devoted staff that took care of him
I am limited in words for the review about the good care before he came home on Tuesday.

That is when communications fell apart. Thursday 1 am we found he had serious diarrhea. One of the things the instruction said to call if it happened and several of the meds stated this could happen, we called about 1:30am and again about 2:30 no one called back. My wife called again about 9am asking if the diarrhea could be caused by one of the medications and if we should stop giving them. His diarrhea continued all day and we stopped giving medication one of which was required to heart arrhythmia which we assume was critical but still no calls back. Our dog was now refusing to eat preventing us to give him medication.

The following day still no return calls we called our regular vet who responded within 30 minutes and after reviewing the Hospital results and instructions gave us a prescription for anti-diarrhea and canned food to try to get food in him to take the other medication but we said we were concerned that one of the medications caused the diarrhea and wanted to wait to hear back from VSH.

The diarrhea slowed but was not gone the following day. We called our regular vet and he the anti-med could take about 12 hours to clear up.
We believe we called VSH again with no response. My wife was furious

Finally, that afternoon I called them any was insisted I speak to someone saying our dog had major surgery and for two day and a half no one has called us back about giving him medication and what we should avoid because of the diarrhea. I said I must speak to someone. She said she would track down a doctor and make sure we were called back. I said this was now urgent since we had to stop the heart medication because of possible diarrhea and nausea.

About an hour later a female doctor called I wish I had her name but she was very concerned about the lack of communications. She answered our question about what medication to avoid and what must be given but said to get him to eat we could get an appetite stimulant prescription.
She did say “not as an excuse we are very busy” I said “sounds like an excuse but if a dog after major surgery on heart medication has to wait over two days someone must consider they need a better way to get answers and need additional personnel”. She said someone will follow up but no one ever did. We thanked her and called our regular vet and received the medication from him. He started to eat and is on his VSH medication.

Very disappointing that after major surgery no one their own or until many calls ever called back to see how he was doing. Every time we take our dog to our regular vet the following day we get a call asking how he is doing. Sadly, it seems they get the most attention up until they receive a large fee then forget.

We called today as instructed to ask about the biopsies and asked about one of the medications as there is a question about stop date. The call was place 9am and still no reply

VSH North County was great with my emergency vet visit for my dog on a Friday afternoon. I called ahead and they were able to see us quickly and immediately address the concerns and provide a treatment plan. Everyone was kind, caring, and professional. Dr. McKee was incredibly knowledgeable, patient with my dog, and provided excellent care throughout the entire emergency visit. The whole team was fantastic. I would highly recommend and would have full confidence bringing a pet to them again.

This place was awesome. They were on time, friendly, and everything was very clean. Dr. Banks was very well educated and explained the situation clearly. Answered all my questions and allowed me to feel comfortable with the plan to best help my cat.

Billed us for euthanasia despite later stating they didn't perform it and that our dog died naturally. And we never discussed or consented to euthanasia. But the medical record falsely states we consented to euthanasia. I DO NOT TRUST THIS PLACE. They also gave me attitude when I was admittedly very upset after our dog died and threatened that they would no longer allow our pet as a patient. Of course, our dog was already dead, so this was a moot point.

We can’t say enough good things about this vet hospital. My dog Otto has epilepsy, and the care he’s received for his seizures has been excellent. Dr. Gangipine clearly loves his patients.  He gets down on the floor to greet Otto and lets him give plenty of kisses before starting the exam. It means so much to see a vet who takes the time to make my dog feel safe and comfortable.

I also really appreciate that I’ve never felt upsold on unnecessary tests or treatments. They recommend what Otto actually needs and are honest about it, which builds a lot of trust. Highly recommend this practice to anyone looking for compassionate, honest veterinary care.

Very professional staff...Dr G is the best very caring and kept us in the know about our dog Kingstons care...the team was very thorough and showed empathy with our challenging time with our family pet...thanks all...Kingston
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! 🌟 We truly appreciate your support and are thrilled you had a great experience. If there’s anything we can do to help again, we’re here! 😊 …

VSH San Marcos is a 5 star veterinarian hospital from their E.R. hospital to their specialist Dr's. My dog Nicholas, has experienced the E.R. stay and is still receiving continued support from their Internal Medicine Dr. Mallory and their heart specialist, Dr. C.  He is still alive and doing well today at 16 yrs old. I am very grateful.

The staff is very professional. The Doctor was very compassionate with me by explaining everything about my dogs blindness. I could tell she cared about her pets she worked on and the pets owners.  Just loved this place.
Thanks so much for the 5-star rating—we truly appreciate your support and can’t wait to serve you again! 🙌 …

Everyone was so kind and helpful during my dog's medical emergency. They diagnosed her promptly and kept us informed of how things were going. We cannot thank them all enough for saving our beloved fur baby!!
I am very thankful for Veterinary Specialty Hospital.  They were so kind and took great care of our little puppy. Great staff.

Mixed feelings.
Didn't want to post because was sad about losing my best girl,
however the last visit my deaf dog with a UTI was treated horribly after waiting, and waiting and being rescheduled they took her in the back, we said WE NEED TO BE WITH HER SHES OLD AND DEAF. They brought her back out shortly after, she was limping, she had struggled and they had no patience? with her. She was euthanized at home when she could no longer walk 24 hrs later. This happened in July 2023. So I've thought it thru. It's not an angry post. It's my experience. A farm for training vets? I can't come back.

I have waited over six months to write this review because I wanted to process my grief before sharing my experience. This is not meant to discourage anyone from seeking care here, but rather to share what happened to my beloved cat, Tux, and why communication and transparency matter so much.

When I arrived on November 13, 2025, around 10–11 a.m., Tux was suffering from severe seizures that had suddenly developed during the final week of his life. The check-in staff acted quickly, compassionately, and with a true sense of urgency. For that, I am sincerely grateful.

After evaluation, I was told the cause of his seizures couldn’t be determined without an MRI. I understood the risks of anesthesia, signed a DNR, and said goodbye before he was taken back. I kissed him, told him I loved him, and reminded him he was the best thing that had ever happened to me.

Later that evening, the neurologist called with what sounded like encouraging news. The MRI suggested onset epilepsy, they planned to increase his Phenobarbital dosage, and requested permission for a spinal tap. I agreed. Before hanging up, I repeatedly asked, “Is he going to be okay?” Each time I was reassured that everything was going to be alright and was encouraged to go have dinner nearby.

During dinner, I received another call saying Tux was taking longer than expected to recover from anesthesia but not to worry. An hour later, I was told he still wasn’t ready to come home and they wanted to keep him overnight. I visited him before leaving. He looked exhausted, barely awake, with watery eyes. I kissed him goodbye and told him Daddy would see him in the morning.

A few hours later, I received the call every pet owner fears: “We’re losing him.”

When I rushed back to the hospital, I was told his brain was swelling and medication had been given to reduce it. To this day, I still don’t fully understand why that happened. Was it related to his illness, the anesthesia, or something else? I don’t know. I’m not making accusations—I simply believe grieving families deserve complete transparency when something changes so dramatically.

The staff gave me privacy to spend Tux’s final moments with him. Eventually, I made the heartbreaking decision to let him go because he was suffering. Only hours earlier, I had been reassured he was going to be okay. That emotional swing is something I wouldn’t wish on anyone.

I understand veterinary medicine is unpredictable, and I truly believe everyone wanted to help my little boy. This review is not about placing blame. It’s about communication. It’s about honesty. It’s about making sure pet owners are fully informed when a patient’s condition changes unexpectedly.

Tux wasn’t just my cat. He was my soul pet, my best friend, and the greatest gift life ever gave me. I hope no family ever has to experience what we went through during those final seven days.

Here are a couple of photos I’d like to share. The first is my beloved Tux. The second is the beautiful double rainbow I saw the following morning. Whether it was coincidence or not, it brought me a small sense of comfort during one of the hardest days of my life.

I am very disappointed and frustrated with my experience at VSH. When I brought my cat into their care, I was asked for both verbal and written consent to perform CPR on my cat. I gave them verbal and written consent to do so if needed. A nurse came into the doctor's office and told me to come see my cat, in my head I was thinking they're going to let me see her before they send me home because the doctor's discussed hospitalizing her overnight - however, with any warning or disclosure, I was brought into their medical room where I saw my cat laying on her side with tubes in her mouth looking absolutely horrifying and the doctor said "she stopped breathing, do you want us to perform CPR?". At that point I was so shocked, overwhelmed, and flooded with every terrible emotion you can imagine after seeing your cat laying lifeless and vulnerable on the table. ​A Message of Eternal Gratitude
​"It has taken me over a year to find the strength to write this, but the debt of gratitude I owe to Veterinary Specialty Hospital is the one I can never truly repay.
​On October 11, 2024, I brought my boy Shaggy to you while some rejected me such as Shadow Bridge in Vista....my boy was 17 years old, he was tired, and he was very sick. At that moment, I was also struggling financially, feeling the crushing weight of being unable to help the puppy who had given me everything.
​I will never forget the nurse who first stepped forward to accept Shaggy. You didn't look at my bank account; but look at Shaggy’s eyes and you saw my heartbreak. You took him in without hesitation or expectation. To the doctor and the front desk staff: you treated us with a level of humanity that is rare in this world... ​When it was time to let him go, you did so with such tenderness and peace. I had pain & tears because my boy was gone, and  took big pice of my soul with him forever...you offered the ashes if i want, but  I said, didn't need to take his ashes home because 'he is in my heart,' and you honored that by spreading him into the ocean. I have spent more than a year overcoming the deep silence he left behind, because he truly was the heroin of my life.. after him I never got happy or smiles from within. To me and my boy, ​You didn't just provide medical care; you provided a miracle of kindness when I was desperate. You ensured Shaggy’s last memory was one of peace and dignity.
I will carry your kindness, and Shaggy’s memory, in my heart forever. As the immortal one is truly the one who survives in others memories and mind. In this world of confusion we need more kindness than strength, and more understanding than money.
With My Best Regard to the Angels of Veterinary Speciaty Hospital of San Marcos.

We are so grateful to Veterinary Specialty Hospital!  They took such excellent care of our dog Roo.  We took her in due to Freon poisoning.  In the beginning her chances of pulling through seemed very slim.  She was having seizures, needed oxygen, her heart rate was erratic and she was in danger of kidney failure.  The doctors were very straightforward with us and didn’t give us false hope, which was so helpful when weighing our options.    Since Roo was in critical condition they let us visit her a lot.  We saw all the hard work that goes on behind the scenes.  Everyone there took such good care of Roo and I know that made all the difference.  We were so lucky to be able to bring Roo home a few days ago and she is almost back to her old self. (learn from my mistake and always have pet insurance!)

We cannot say enough about the incredible care we’ve received at Veterinary Specialty Hospital – North County, especially from neurologist Dr. John Gagnepain.

Years ago, Dr. Gagnepain quite literally saved our dog Lola’s life through his early diagnosis of what could have been a fatal case of IVDD. His expertise, attentiveness, and decisiveness made all the difference during a terrifying time for our family.

More recently, he did it again—this time for our dog CeCe. She developed severe inner-ear infections that left her unable to walk, and we were devastated. Dr. Gagnepain went above and beyond, even coming into the office specifically to see her urgently. He ensured she received an MRI and spinal tap right away, which led to a fast and accurate diagnosis and treatment plan.

His level of care is nothing short of exceptional. Not only is he brilliant in his field, but his compassion and commitment to his patients truly set him apart. His follow-up care is equally outstanding—thorough, responsive, and genuinely invested in each animal’s recovery.

We are endlessly grateful to Dr. Gagnepain and the team at Veterinary Specialty Hospital – North County. If your pet ever needs neurological care, you could not be in better hands.

We can’t thank Dr. Gagnepain, Dr. Godoy, and their team enough for the incredible care they gave our chiweenie, Jax. Facing neck spinal surgery was overwhelming, but they made the entire experience so much more manageable through their compassion, expertise, and constant communication.

They kept us updated every step of the way and checked in frequently, which really helped calm our nerves during such a stressful time. Every question we had—even non-urgent ones—was answered promptly and thoughtfully, and we always felt heard and supported.

What truly stood out was how much they genuinely care. They took extra precautions to ensure Jax received the best possible care and worked with us to make sure treatment was feasible within our means. That level of empathy and dedication meant everything to us.

We always felt Jax was in the best hands, and we’re so grateful for the outcome. We would absolutely recommend Dr. Gagnepain, Dr. Godoy, and their team to anyone needing exceptional veterinary care. We wouldn’t hesitate to return in an emergency.

Thank you for taking such amazing care of Jax!
